headline: A law renames a U.S. Postal Service facility in McArthur, California, after Janet Lucille Oilar.
what_it_does: This law names the Postal Service building at 44160 State Highway 299 East Suite 1 in McArthur, California, the "Janet Lucille Oilar Post Office." It changes only the name of the facility. It does not change postal services, hours, or rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2018, and took effect on that date.
